title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 4122 Madison Street, Elfers, Florida, as the "Private First Class Felton Roger Fussell Memorial Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 4122 Madison Street, Elfers, Florida, as the "Private First Class Felton Roger Fussell Memorial Post Office."

summary.headline: Names a post office in Elfers, Florida after Private First Class Felton Roger Fussell.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 4122 Madison Street in Elfers, Florida, as the Private First Class Felton Roger Fussell Memorial Post Office. It changes only the official name of the building and does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 29, 2016, and the new name applied from that date.
